title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government is responding to a report on artificial intelligence and public standards by outlining its position on this issue. The response aims to address the committee's recommendations and provide a clear direction for how the government will handle AI in relation to public standards.

title: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education
description: The Department for Education’s (DfE) position on the use of generative AI in the education sector.
summary: This policy document outlines the Department for Education's stance on using generative AI tools in educational settings. It aims to provide a framework for the responsible use of generative AI in education to support teaching and learning.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual is creating a policy to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in qualifications. This policy was developed in response to requests from government departments concerned with education and technology.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: The report assesses the impact of using copyrighted material in the development of artificial intelligence systems. It examines the copyright implications of AI creation.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has responded to a House of Lords Select Committee report on Artificial Intelligence, with the intention to address concerns and challenges raised in the report. The government's response outlines its plans and policies to ensure the beneficial development and use of AI in the UK.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the terms of reference and frequently asked questions for a committee reviewing the relationship between artificial intelligence and public standards. The review aims to examine how AI interacts with public standards in society.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The UK's Committee on Standards in Public Life (CSPL) has provided evidence to a parliamentary inquiry into how artificial intelligence should be governed. The submission likely offers recommendations for overseeing the development and use of AI in the UK.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary:
This policy document explores how artificial intelligence affects the regulation and approval of medical products. 

It aims to implement principles outlined in the Artificial Intelligence White Paper to address these changes.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence department aims to become the world's leading Defence organisation in the use of Artificial Intelligence. This is based on the goals of efficiency, effectiveness, trustworthiness, and global influence.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: The Transport artificial intelligence action plan outlines how the Department for Transport will work with the transport sector to develop and use AI technology. This aims to maximize the benefits of AI while minimizing potential risks in the transport system.
